payload.description_html: Figure 4: Anterior portion of the skull of Dakotadon lakotaensis (SDSM 8656). (A) photograph in left lateral view; (B) photograph in right lateral view; (C) photograph in ventral view. Abbreviations: ant, anterior; post, posterior; vent, ventral. Scale bars equal 5.0 cm.
